{{DISPLAYTITLE:Lilith (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA Lilith Portrait.gif|right]]
[[File:FFTA-spr-Lilith.gif|50px|left]]
{{Quote|Powerful lamia that delights in taking life.|Description}}
The '''Lilith''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a blue variant of the [[Lamia (Tactics Advance)|Lamia]]. They have relatively high [[HP (stat)|HP]] and Attack power, and their skills can inflict a myriad of [[status effect]]s on the party.

{{See|Lilith}}

!Turf Defense Mission: Help Uladon!
|All four units here can be quickly incapacitated by a well-placed Poison Frog from the Lilith.

|This is probably the first time a Lilith will be encountered.
|-
!Mission #058: Royal Ruins
|A Lilith is a Ruin Ward that guards the two mysterious goat-statues.
|-
!Mission #092: Cursed Bride
|A level 26 Lilith that has been masquerading as a human fights alone against the four party members.
|-
!Mission #077: Free Baguba!
|This incarnation of the [[Magus Sisters]] are three Liliths, who are of course named Mindy, Cindy, and Sandy.
|-
!Mission #022: To Ambervale
|Five powerful enemies intercept [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] and co. at a narrow valley. The Lilith is the farthest monster from the party and will rain her skills down from the upper ledge if allowed.
|}
